items.body:
Preserve user prompt URL destinations across terminal widths

## Why

User prompt URLs only received explicit hyperlink destinations when they required forced wrapping, leaving other URLs without those annotations.

## What changed

Annotate web URLs before wrapping user messages so their full destinations survive both adaptive wrapping and forced splitting of oversized URLs.

## Testing

Add a regression test and snapshot at widths of 120, 60, and 24 columns, checking URL destinations, line width limits, and matching display and transcript output, including a prompt with an image placeholder and a parenthesized URL.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 666721dac7723a46cf4ad5f1e4b309e7aefb4967e888d46461b95e32c33173de -->
items.title: Preserve user prompt URL destinations across terminal widths

items.body:
Restrict Windows sandbox default object access to the logon session

## Why

Shared filesystem capabilities must not grant access to another logon session's processes, threads, or IPC objects. A shared account's implicit owner rights can also allow another logon to rewrite an object's DACL.

## What changed

- Grant full access in the token's default DACL only to the runner's logon SID, removing grants to Everyone and capability SIDs.
- Add an `OWNER RIGHTS` entry granting only `READ_CONTROL` to suppress the owner's implicit `WRITE_DAC` access.
- Close the new token handle if default DACL or privilege setup fails.

## Testing

Add a Windows `AccessCheck` regression test verifying that process memory, thread creation, termination, query, and DACL modification rights remain available to the creating logon but are denied to a simulated other logon sharing the same owner and capability.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 184f8b2fa1066006c5d5e1ecb920f463486b87a2cf2ad7f6ee3e747d2ce670a3 -->
items.title: Restrict Windows sandbox default object access to the logon session

items.body:
Bound inbound exec-server requests across client transports

## What changed

- Enforce an 8 KiB encoded-message limit for requests, unrecognized notifications, and malformed messages received by exec-server clients over stdio, WebSocket, relay, and Noise relay transports.
- Allow process output, exit, close, and HTTP request body notifications up to 2 MiB. Keep responses and errors subject to existing transport limits, and preserve executor-side request limits.
- Read stdio stderr in chunks of at most 8 KiB.
- Drop outgoing server-request `tracestate` values larger than 512 bytes while preserving `traceparent`.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for oversized requests across transports, malformed messages, requests wrapped in `RawValue`, fragmented Noise messages, large responses, streamed notifications, and trace-context preservation.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 81f6bf19dc5799fb6429aa5d5061934b8e7de2c00c6c0ad0a84543be132e0eff -->
items.title: Bound inbound exec-server requests across client transports

items.body:
Resume model context from the latest compaction boundary

## Why

Resuming a compacted thread should use the compaction and its newer records without depending on older turn contexts or restoring stale state from before the compaction.

## What changed

- Stop paginated model-context scans at the newest compaction with `replacement_history` and `window_number`. Fall back to full replay if the newest compaction lacks either field.
- Align reconstruction with that boundary and restore `last_started_turn_id`, previous turn settings, and the multi-agent version from compaction resume metadata. Allow newer completed turns to override the saved settings.
- Keep canonical session metadata alongside the bounded replay and use the same scan boundary for subagent rollout migration.

## Testing

Add coverage for cold resume after mid-turn compaction, bounded/full replay equivalence, missing companion state, settings precedence, and incomplete-compaction fallback.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: cdd2a121417ccc754034baab39884cd3518ffba9a85ce1d076a1ff65e96809f8 -->
items.title: Resume model context from the latest compaction boundary

items.body:
Overlap agent metadata reads when resuming a V2 root

## Why

Restoring persisted V2 agent identities reads descendant metadata serially, making each storage read wait for the previous one.

## What changed

Read up to eight descendants concurrently while registering identities in graph order, preserving path and nickname reservation order. Skip identities already registered and continue restoring after individual read failures.

## Testing

Add a cold-resume regression test that gates child metadata reads to verify overlap, completes reads out of order to check deterministic path reservation, and injects a read failure. It also verifies that child runtimes remain unloaded until requested.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: f7b989af58dd6746ea6397a38a1e03b0a615028c5a7834805924cc578320de04 -->
items.title: Overlap agent metadata reads when resuming a V2 root

items.body:
Add an opt-in preference for the local MXC sandbox

## What changed

Add the default-off `features.prefer_mxc` flag to select MXC for local Windows execution when native support is available and effective network settings do not explicitly forbid local binding. Otherwise, retain the configured backend and legacy setup behavior.

Resolve the preference during config loading and use the effective local backend for execution, network proxy setup, sandbox diagnostics, and `windowsSandbox/readiness`. Preserve the configured backend for remote executors and `config/read`. Explicit `windows.sandbox = "mxc"` remains strict, and command failures do not trigger backend fallback.

## Testing

Add coverage for preference resolution, startup readiness without rewriting configuration, local and remote backend selection across environment updates and child threads, and workspace-write permission context in an agent turn.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 9f713982e69f912a9587f0c97352ed3ecd359f69be55e51fd28c7320cd8494a4 -->
items.title: Add an opt-in preference for the local MXC sandbox

items.body:
Add opt-in reasoning status for realtime V3 delegations

## What changed

Add `backend_reasoning_status`, disabled by default, to relay public reasoning summaries during active, server-managed realtime V3 delegations.

Use the last non-empty summary from each completed reasoning item, truncate it to 256 bytes at a character boundary, and append it as `[STATUS]` context on the `commentary` channel. Discard queued updates if their delegation is no longer active.

## Testing

Add an integration test covering enabled and disabled behavior, selection of the latest non-empty summary, exclusion of raw reasoning and partial summaries, and delivery without triggering `response.create` or changing the model's reasoning-summary setting.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: b142ec3c0bf09ec623e9fd9e60c8d26f7be93097cd94a8dbddb7540bac975d63 -->
items.title: Add opt-in reasoning status for realtime V3 delegations

items.body:
Route TUI voice controls through the app

## What changed

- Handle voice toggle and mute shortcuts in `App`, and route `/voice`, `/voice stop`, and `/voice mute` through thread-scoped events that ignore requests for a different current thread.
- Allow function-key voice toggle bindings and chords beyond chat, including transcript browsing and search, while preserving existing surface bindings and raw key capture.
- Exit transcript browsing when toggling voice, avoid matching completed chords again, and preserve startup submission handling before dispatch.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for voice chords outside chat, binding conflicts, key capture, transcript browsing, mute dispatch, and startup submission cancellation with draft preservation.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 740abab3bf3436ed1742e6cd31ea1f68dcf7512924032ee35609f99d201d4916 -->

items.body:
Keep voice conversations running across TUI thread navigation

## Why

Switching threads stopped the active voice conversation. Users should be able to view another task while continuing the call on its original thread.

## What changed

- Retain the voice owner's live widget and subscription in the background, routing voice controls, speech, and connection callbacks to that owner.
- Restore the live call and transcript when returning to its thread, without duplicating captions or letting background UI events affect the visible task.
- Preserve undelivered speech and defer background errors until the owning thread is shown.
- Stop background voice on shutdown, disconnect, or removal of the owning session.

## Testing

Extend regression and end-to-end coverage for thread switching during delegated speech, voice control routing, transcript restoration, caption deduplication, and cleanup on disconnect or archive/delete.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 008c08b9e68bcf9e6c826e6ee3267270bd74a7a3fbb4b08fb5856db0ebf8da25 -->
items.title: Keep voice conversations running across TUI thread navigation

Restore composer hints after clearing selection at the transcript bottom

## Why

Selecting text can pause following while the final transcript row remains visible. Clearing that selection could leave an unnecessary `esc latest` hint in place of the composer hints.

## What changed

Only show the return-to-latest footer for paused navigation when the transcript tail is out of view. At the bottom, show selection shortcuts without the earlier-history status, then restore composer hints when the selection is cleared, even if following remains paused. Preserve loading and retry hints.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for selection, clicking away, and scrolling at the bottom with partial and complete history, plus selection above the bottom. Verify retry hints with selected text and update activity expectations and the composer-gap snapshot.

items.body:
Enforce network policy throughout HTTP and WebSocket requests

## Why

Destination restrictions and policy revocation must remain effective during redirects, response body reads, and established WebSocket traffic. Policy denials must also survive error handling so callers do not retry them or report a revoked operation as successful.

## What changed

- Route managed HTTP clients through a shared `RequestBuilder` and policy-aware execution, checking each redirect destination before route resolution and retaining a network permit while consuming response bodies.
- Guard WebSocket connection setup, reads, and writes with revocable permits, including independent wakeups for split readers and writers.
- Preserve `TransportError::Policy` through HTTP, SSE, and realtime error handling, and treat policy denials as non-retryable.
- Keep the supplied network policy in plugin startup HTTP requests and propagate response body failures from backend and plugin requests.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for rejection before connecting, revocation during redirect routing and streamed body reads, split WebSocket revocation, realtime writer error propagation, and revoked plugin upload responses.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 2e105c5bf69f3ae86bdf1ae48c7c8637b7968542abb31c99cc068abdea180a3f -->
items.title: Enforce network policy throughout HTTP and WebSocket requests

items.body:
Retry transient OpenAI file blob upload failures

## Why

A single blob upload failure previously aborted the file upload, even for a temporary `503` response or an interrupted stream.

## What changed

- Retry `503` responses and timeout, connection, body, or request errors, with at most five attempts within a shared five-minute deadline.
- Honor `x-ms-retry-after-ms` and `Retry-After`, falling back to backoff when no valid server delay is available.
- Reopen the contents for each retry while reusing the same file record and upload URL. Preserve the initial read permission check and reopen MCP file streams under the same sandbox policy.
- Record retry, recovery, and terminal failure events with a fresh client request ID for each attempt.

## Testing

Add coverage for recovery after `503` responses and interrupted streams, attempt and deadline limits, non-retryable responses, retry delay parsing, and unique request IDs. Extend the restricted-read MCP upload test to verify that both attempts send the complete file contents.

<!-- copyberry-projection-id: 032fcbba62c729b6ef6cac444b342960071e299a6c3edbada216fdf168a1ed20 -->
items.title: Retry transient OpenAI file blob upload failures
